_doc: Endless ammo of the ranged basic attack (spec #151 #155, docs/GAME_DESIGN.md 'Ranged basic attack and endless ammo'). Ammo is never consumed and never an item: a ranged weapon family (WeaponInfo.RANGED_FAMILIES) always has one current ammo item, and its Item.wz incPAD (tier A) adds to W.Att for ranged attacks and its `bullet` animation is the projectile sprite. `families.<family>.start` is the ammo every character of that weapon family starts with and keeps unless a schedule upgrades it (tier A ids: the Beginner Thief's Throwing Stars, Arrow for Bow, Arrow for Crossbow, Bullet). `schedules` upgrade it by character level for one specialist branch (the branch job and its advancements): the highest step whose level is reached applies, also when the character advances into the branch already past it. Each step carries its provenance tier (A = the item's own v83 reqLevel; C = our level pacing; the item ids and the incPAD in Item.wz are tier A). A schedule only upgrades ammo of its own `family`. `projectile` is the shot of the family's basic attack: speed in px/s, radius in px, whether the sprite turns to its direction (arrows and bullets do; stars spin in their own animation), and `overshoot`, the px a shot flies past the family's reach (WeaponInfo.RANGED_REACH) so a target at the edge of the reach is still hit. All projectile numbers are tier C (ours); `noun` is what the upgrade notice calls the ammo.
